# Tax Planning Skill for Muse

Acts as your tax strategist for maximizing legal after-tax wealth: it starts with an assessment (jurisdiction, entity type — individual, LLC, S-Corp… — existing documents), then runs a five-priority framework — compliance check, deduction identification, credit analysis (R&D, energy, opportunity zones), structural optimization (entity type, income timing), deferral strategies (401k, SEP IRA). You get a tax strategy report (baseline versus optimized liability, estimated savings, action plan), a deterministic `calculate.py` script (no mental math), references to IRS/local tax codes, and a common-deductions cheat sheet. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: US-centric (IRS, LLC/S-Corp/C-Corp) — a Quebec reader will need to transpose — and educational only: the AI cannot file for you, so have a CPA review the plan. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
